articles.title: Daytime Darkness! A Total Solar Eclipse Is Coming to Spain and Iceland
articles.summary: On August 12, the moon will block the sun over Spain, Iceland, and Greenland for up to 2 minutes and 18 seconds. It's the first total eclipse in mainland Spain in over 100 years!

articles.title: Coach Pochettino Stays! U.S. Men's Soccer Team Keeps Its Star Leader Through 2030
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino, the coach of the U.S. men's soccer team, signed a new contract to stay through the 2030 World Cup. He led the team to its best World Cup ever, with three wins and a record 50.1 million TV viewers.

articles.title: Iran Says It's Talking to Oman, Not the U.S., About Reopening a Key Waterway
articles.summary: Iran says it is negotiating with Oman to let ships pass through the Strait of Hormuz again. President Trump says the U.S. controls the strait and wants a deal, but Iran denies talking directly to America.
